diagnosis.diagnosis: The tool leaks the credential in log messages when the authentication provider fails, as evidenced by the logging channel showing 'provider rejected credential=[REDACTED]' in the failure observation. This violates the requirement that credentials must never appear in returned values, keys, stdout, stderr, or logging.
